title: Edgar Dick
dek_or_short_description: PKD's brother. Family correspondence about personal and family matters.
body_markdown:
Edgar Dick was PKD's brother, and the surviving letters show the basic maintenance of family relationship — communication about family matters, updates on personal circumstances. Unlike the intimate friendships or romantic relationships that dominate PKD's correspondence, the letters to his brother are more formally cordial.

This is not unusual. Family relationships often function differently from chosen friendships. Edgar appears in the archive as a point of family continuity, someone with whom PKD maintained contact despite the distance and disruption in his own life.

What is notable is how little appears to have been shared between the brothers. The surviving letters contain no evidence of the kind of emotional intensity or intellectual exchange that marked PKD's correspondence with writers, scholars, and close friends. Edgar represents the obligation of kinship — important, stable, but not intimate in the way that truly close relationships were.
summary: Edgar Dick (1972–1973+), PKD's brother. Family correspondence about personal and family matters.
